title: Design: the # and Matrices info tooltips on the Tiers list
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Point at the info icon beside the # header.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • An info icon shows beside # and beside Matrices in the header.

Step 2:

  • A dark gray tooltip just below the icon reads "The tier's place in the order. New tiers go last; archiving one moves later tiers up."
  • The tooltip's position and colours match picture 2.3 compared with the design picture at 100% zoom.

AUTOMATION: Not available on Build to test Yet - Last checked 11/14/2026
